name: toggle-group
title: Toggle group
description: A row of toggles where one or several can be on.
a11y: single type is role=radiogroup with radio items; multiple type is a group of toggle buttons.
Arrow keys move focus between items; Space and Enter toggle.
usage:
import {ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem} from '@monoline/react';

<ToggleGroup type="single" defaultValue="30" aria-label="Range"><ToggleGroupItem value="7">7 days</ToggleGroupItem><ToggleGroupItem value="30">30 days</ToggleGroupItem><ToggleGroupItem value="365">Year</ToggleGroupItem></ToggleGroup>
